verses.sloka: तत: पुरुषसिंहानां वृतानां तै: सुहृद्गणै: ।शोचतामेव रजनी दु:खेन व्यत्यवर्त्तत ॥ २.१०५.१॥
verses.transliteration: tata: puruṣasiṁhānāṁ vṛtānāṁ tai: suhṛdgaṇai: ।śocatāmeva rajanī du:khena vyatyavarttata ॥ 2.105.1॥

translations.english: That night passed off painfully for the four lion like brothers as they lamented, surrounded by their hosts of friends.

verses.sloka: रजन्यां सुप्रभातायां भ्रातरस्ते सुहृद्वृता: ।मन्दाकिन्यां हुतं जप्यं कृत्वा राममुपागमन् ॥ २.१०५.२॥
verses.transliteration: rajanyāṁ suprabhātāyāṁ bhrātaraste suhṛdvṛtā: ।mandākinyāṁ hutaṁ japyaṁ kṛtvā rāmamupāgaman ॥ 2.105.2॥

translations.english: When the night dawned, those brothers surrounded by their friends made (morning) ablutions and, after the prayers, returned to Rama.
translations.hindi: हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ ! हमारे कुल में तो सदा से यह रीति चली श्राती है कि बड़े पुत्र के सामने छोटा पुत्र राजा नहीं हो सकता ?

verses.sloka: तूष्णीं ते समुपासीना न कश्चित्किञ्चिदब्रवीत् ।भरतस्तु सुहृन्मध्ये रामं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ २.१०५.३॥
verses.transliteration: tūṣṇīṁ te samupāsīnā na kaścitkiñcidabravīt ।bharatastu suhṛnmadhye rāmaṁ vacanamabravīt ॥ 2.105.3॥

translations.english: All of them sat together silently and no one uttered a word. Bharata alone from among them addressed Rama saying:
translations.hindi: राम (पछतावे से) दोनों हाथ मलते हुए कुल्हाड़े से काट हुए पुषिपत खृक्ष की तरह पृथिवी पर गिर पड़े

verses.sloka: सान्त्विता मामिका माता दत्तं राज्यमिदं मम ।तद्ददामि तवैवाहं भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यमकण्टकम् ॥ २.१०५.४॥
verses.transliteration: sāntvitā māmikā mātā dattaṁ rājyamidaṁ mama ।taddadāmi tavaivāhaṁ bhuṅkṣva rājyamakaṇṭakam ॥ 2.105.4॥

translations.english: This kingdom was given to me for the satisfaction of my mother. I am bestowing it back on you. Enjoy it without any obstacles.
translations.hindi: घर्मविहीनस्य--स्वकुलोचितरीतेः विहीनस्य । (शि०) २ भवाय भद्राय । (गो०) लोग राजा को भले ही मनुष्य कहा करें, किन्तु में तो राजा को देवता समझता हूँ । क्योंकि उसके धर्म ग्रौर ग्रथ से ग्रनुमोदित चरित लोकोत्तर होते हे श्र्थात्‌ साधारण मनुष्य से भिन्न होते हु

verses.sloka: महतेवाम्बुवेगेन भिन्न: सेतुर्जलागमे ।दुरावारं त्वदन्येन राज्यखण्डमिदं महत् ॥ २.१०५.५॥
verses.transliteration: mahatevāmbuvegena bhinna: seturjalāgame ।durāvāraṁ tvadanyena rājyakhaṇḍamidaṁ mahat ॥ 2.105.5॥

translations.english: Like a dyke bursts under pressure by the great surge of waters during the rainy season, this vast kingdom cannot be sustained by any one except yourself.
translations.hindi: जब में ग्रपनी ननिहाल केकयराज्य में था और तुम वन में चले ग्राए थे, तब अनेक यज्ञ करने वाले तथा साधु सज्जन लोगों से प्रशंसित भहाराज दशरथ स्वर्ग को तिधारे

verses.sloka: गतिं खर इवाश्वस्य तार्क्ष्यस्येव पतत्ऺित्रण: ।अनुगन्तुं न शक्तिर्मे गतिं तव महीपते ॥ २.१०५.६॥
verses.transliteration: gatiṁ khara ivāśvasya tārkṣyasyeva patatऺitraṇa: ।anugantuṁ na śaktirme gatiṁ tava mahīpate ॥ 2.105.6॥

translations.english: O lord of the earth as an ass cannot follow the pace of a horse or a bird, the pace of Tarkshya (Garuda), I do not have the capability to follow you.
translations.hindi: सीता और लक्ष्मण के साथ तुम्हारे भ्रयोध्या छोड़ते ही, महाराज दुःख श्रौर शोक से ऐसे विकल हुए कि उन्हें स्वर्ग को जाना पड़ा

verses.sloka: सुजीवं नित्यशस्तस्य य: परैरुपजीव्यते ।राम तेन तु दुर्जीवं य: परानुपजीवति ॥ २.१०५.७॥
verses.transliteration: sujīvaṁ nityaśastasya ya: parairupajīvyate ।rāma tena tu durjīvaṁ ya: parānupajīvati ॥ 2.105.7॥

translations.english: O Rama, the life of a man on whom others depend for their sustenance is a happy life and the life of one who depends on others for his own mintenance is miserable.
translations.hindi: हे पुरर्षासह ! श्रब इस समय उठ खड़े होइए श्रौर नदी तट पर चलकर पिता को जलाञ्जलि दीजिए । श्त्रध्न और में तो पहिले ही जलाञजलि दे चुका हूँ

verses.sloka: यथा तु रोपितो वृक्ष: पुरुषेण विवर्द्धित: ।ह्रस्वकेन दुरारोहो रूढस्कन्धो महाद्रुम: ॥ २.१०५.८॥
verses.transliteration: yathā tu ropito vṛkṣa: puruṣeṇa vivarddhita: ।hrasvakena durāroho rūḍhaskandho mahādruma: ॥ 2.105.8॥

translations.english: O mightyarmed Rama, a man plants a tree, rears it till it grows into such a large tree with a big trunk that it becomes difficult for a dwarf to climb. When the tree flowers but does not bear fruit, the man who planted it gets no pleasure out of the purpose for which the tree was planted. Being a mighty protector, do not chastise us who are your servants. This is a simile. You may better comprehend its implications. (The meaning of the simile is that if you do not assume the throne, the desire of our father, who nurtured you right from your childhood and hoped that one day you will become king and rule the people, will be in vain.)
translations.hindi: ग्योध्याकाण्ड रते हे कि प्रिय पुत्र का दिया हुआ पिण्ड हे ! लोग कहा क 6 4 कर बना रहता है, सो श्राप पिता जी झौर जल पितृलोक में प्रक्षय्य हो के प्रिय पुत्र हें

verses.sloka: स यथा पुष्पितो भूत्वा फलानि न विदर्शयेत् ।स तां नानुभवेत्प्रीतिं यस्य हेतो: प्ररोपित: ॥ २.१०५.९॥
verses.transliteration: sa yathā puṣpito bhūtvā phalāni na vidarśayet ।sa tāṁ nānubhavetprītiṁ yasya heto: praropita: ॥ 2.105.9॥

translations.english: O mightyarmed Rama, a man plants a tree, rears it till it grows into such a large tree with a big trunk that it becomes difficult for a dwarf to climb. When the tree flowers but does not bear fruit, the man who planted it gets no pleasure out of the purpose for which the tree was planted. Being a mighty protector, do not chastise us who are your servants. This is a simile. You may better comprehend its implications. (The meaning of the simile is that if you do not assume the throne, the desire of our father, who nurtured you right from your childhood and hoped that one day you will become king and rule the people, will be in vain.)

verses.sloka: एषोपमा महाबाहो तमर्थं वेत्तुमर्हसि ।यदि त्वमस्मान् वृषभो भर्त्ता भृत्यान्न शाधि हि ॥ २.१०५.१०॥
verses.transliteration: eṣopamā mahābāho tamarthaṁ vettumarhasi ।yadi tvamasmān vṛṣabho bharttā bhṛtyānna śādhi hi ॥ 2.105.10॥

translations.english: O mightyarmed Rama, a man plants a tree, rears it till it grows into such a large tree with a big trunk that it becomes difficult for a dwarf to climb. When the tree flowers but does not bear fruit, the man who planted it gets no pleasure out of the purpose for which the tree was planted. Being a mighty protector, do not chastise us who are your servants. This is a simile. You may better comprehend its implications. (The meaning of the simile is that if you do not assume the throne, the desire of our father, who nurtured you right from your childhood and hoped that one day you will become king and rule the people, will be in vain.)

verses.sloka: श्रेणयस्त्वां महाराज पश्यन्त्वग्र्याश्च सर्वश: ।प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यं राज्ये स्थितमरिन्दमम् ॥ २.१०५.११॥
verses.transliteration: śreṇayastvāṁ mahārāja paśyantvagryāśca sarvaśa: ।pratapantamivādityaṁ rājye sthitamarindamam ॥ 2.105.11॥

translations.english: O great king and subduer of enemies, may all the leading guilds of traders and other subjects behold you all over installed in the kingdom like the resplendent Sun.
translations.hindi: + पाठान्तरे--“उपाक्रामत । हे निष्पाप भरत ! तुम्हीं अच्छे रहे कि, तुमने ओर शत्रुन्न ने पिता जी के सम्पूणं अन्त्येष्टिकर्म तो कर लिए |¦ १० ॥ निष्प्रधानामनेकाग्रां? नरे न्द्रेण विनाकृम्‌ । निध्चवनवासो5पि नायोष्यां गन्तुसुत्सहे

verses.sloka: तवा ऽनुयाने काकुत्स्थ मत्ता नर्दन्तु कुञ्जरा: ।अन्त:पुरगता नार्यो नन्दन्तु सुसमाहिता: ॥ २.१०५.१२॥
verses.transliteration: tavā 'nuyāne kākutstha mattā nardantu kuñjarā: ।anta:puragatā nāryo nandantu susamāhitā: ॥ 2.105.12॥

translations.english: O Rama, let the elephants following you, intoxicated with ichor, be heard trumpeting. Let the women of the inner apartment rejoice with composed minds (when they hear of your return).

verses.sloka: तस्य साध्वित्यमन्यन्त नागरा विविधा जना: ।भरतस्य वच: श्रुत्वा रामं प्रत्यनुयाचत: ॥ २.१०५.१३॥
verses.transliteration: tasya sādhvityamanyanta nāgarā vividhā janā: ।bharatasya vaca: śrutvā rāmaṁ pratyanuyācata: ॥ 2.105.13॥

translations.english: Hearing the words of Bharata beseeching Rama to return, various classes of people of the city of Ayodhya, in approbation exclaimed well said.
translations.hindi: मेरे सदू आचरणों को देख, पिता जी मुमे स्नेहपूर्वक जो उपदेश देते थे, अत्र उन कणेसुखद उपदेशों को, “मैं वहाँ किससे सुनूंगा ?

verses.sloka: तमेवं दु:खितं प्रेक्ष्य विलपन्तं यशस्विनम् ।राम: कृतात्मा भरतं समाश्वासय दात्मवान् ॥ २.१०५.१४॥
verses.transliteration: tamevaṁ du:khitaṁ prekṣya vilapantaṁ yaśasvinam ।rāma: kṛtātmā bharataṁ samāśvāsaya dātmavān ॥ 2.105.14॥

translations.english: Having seen the illustrious Bharata lamenting that way, Rama, a man of firm determination and selfpossession, consoled him thus:
translations.hindi: अनेकाभ्रां -स्वार्थ्यरह्वितां । (शि०) २ श्रनुशासिष्यति--हिता- हित बिषय प्रबृत्ति निवृत्तिकारयिष्यति | ( रा० ) शोकसन्तप्त श्रीरामचन्द्र जी भरत जी से यह कह कर और सीता की ओर मुख कर, पूर्णमासी के चन्द्रमा सदृश सुख चाली जानकी से बोले

verses.sloka: नात्मन: कामकारो ऽस्ति पुरुषो ऽयमनीश्वर: ।इतश्चेतरतश्चैनं कृतान्त: परिकर्षति ॥ २.१०५.१५॥
verses.transliteration: nātmana: kāmakāro 'sti puruṣo 'yamanīśvara: ।itaścetarataścainaṁ kṛtānta: parikarṣati ॥ 2.105.15॥

translations.english: A man is neither independent nor competent to do any act on his free will. Fate pulls him this way or the other.

verses.sloka: सर्वे क्षयान्ता निचया: पतनान्ता: समुच्छ्रया: ।संयोगा विप्रयोगान्ता मरणान्तं च जीवितम् ॥ २.१०५.१६॥
verses.transliteration: sarve kṣayāntā nicayā: patanāntā: samucchrayā: ।saṁyogā viprayogāntā maraṇāntaṁ ca jīvitam ॥ 2.105.16॥

translations.english: All accumulations of wealth deplete at the end. Every man who attains elevated positions falls at the end. Every union culminates in separation. Every life ends in death.
translations.hindi: तब रुदन करती हुई जानकी जी को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने समका बुझाकर धीरज बंधाया । फिर शोक से विकल हो, श्री रामचन्द्रजी ने, दुःखित लक्ष्मक्त जो से कहा

verses.sloka: यथा फलानां पक्वानां नान्यत्र पतनाद्भयम् ।एवं नरस्य जातस्य नान्यत्र मरणाद्भयम् ॥ २.१०५.१७॥
verses.transliteration: yathā phalānāṁ pakvānāṁ nānyatra patanādbhayam ।evaṁ narasya jātasya nānyatra maraṇādbhayam ॥ 2.105.17॥

translations.english: The only fear of a ripened fruit is the fear of falling down (from the tree). In the same way every man who is born has no other fear except the fear of death.
translations.hindi: हे सीते ! तुम्हारे मसुर स्वर्ग सिधारे । हे लक्ष्मण ! तुम पिता- हीन हो गए । क्योंकि महाराज के स्वगंबास का यह दुःखदायी संवाद मुझे भरत जी से अवगत हुआ हे

verses.sloka: यथागारं दृढस्थूणं जीर्णं भूत्वा ऽवसीदति ।तथैव सीदन्ति नरा जरामृत्युवशङ्गता: ॥ २.१०५.१८॥
verses.transliteration: yathāgāraṁ dṛḍhasthūṇaṁ jīrṇaṁ bhūtvā 'vasīdati ।tathaiva sīdanti narā jarāmṛtyuvaśaṅgatā: ॥ 2.105.18॥

translations.english: Even a house constructed with sturdy pillars gets dilapidated and ultimately decays. In the same way people under the sway of old age and death are destroyed (at last).

verses.sloka: अत्येति रजनी या तु सा न प्रतिनिवर्त्तते ।यात्येव यमुना पूर्णा समुद्रमुदकाकुलम् ॥ २.१०५.१९॥
verses.transliteration: atyeti rajanī yā tu sā na pratinivarttate ।yātyeva yamunā pūrṇā samudramudakākulam ॥ 2.105.19॥

translations.english: A night that once passe off does not return like the waters of river Yamuna that flow into the ocean filled with water (the water do not flow back into Yamuna).

verses.sloka: अहोरात्राणि गच्छन्ति सर्वेषां प्राणिनामिह ।आयूंषि क्षपयन्त्याशु ग्रीष्मे जलमिवांशव: ॥ २.१०५.२०॥
verses.transliteration: ahorātrāṇi gacchanti sarveṣāṁ prāṇināmiha ।āyūṁṣi kṣapayantyāśu grīṣme jalamivāṁśava: ॥ 2.105.20॥

translations.english: The passing days and nights quickly decrease the life span of all living beings in this world, like sunrays drying up the water in summer.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! तुम इस समय इ गुदी के बीजों (हिगोट) को ' पीस कर ले आओ और एक नया चीर मेरे पहिनने के लिए ले आओ । अब मैं पिता जी को जलाञ्जलि दने को चलता हूँ

verses.sloka: आत्मानमनुशोच त्वं किमन्यमनुशोचसि ।आयुस्ते हीयते यस्य स्थितस्य च गतस्य च ॥ २.१०५.२१॥
verses.transliteration: ātmānamanuśoca tvaṁ kimanyamanuśocasi ।āyuste hīyate yasya sthitasya ca gatasya ca ॥ 2.105.21॥

translations.english: Whether you are static or moving, your lifespan decreases. Therefore, you should only grieve about yourself and not for any one else.
translations.hindi: सीता आगे आगे चले और तुम इनके पीछे चलो और मैं सब के पीछे चलूँगा । क्योंकि इस दारुण समय में चलने का यही विधान है

verses.sloka: सहैव मृत्युर्व्रजति सह मृत्युर्निषीदति ।गत्वा सुदीर्घमध्वानं सहमृत्युर्निवर्तते ॥ २.१०५.२२॥
verses.transliteration: sahaiva mṛtyurvrajati saha mṛtyurniṣīdati ।gatvā sudīrghamadhvānaṁ sahamṛtyurnivartate ॥ 2.105.22॥

translations.english: Death follows a man wherever he goes. When he sits, death sits with him. Even after travelling a very long distance, the man returns along with death.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी-ऐसे समय में चलने के लिये घर्मेसूत्र का बह प्रमाण है-- “सर्वे कनिष्ठप्रथमा अनुपूर्वइतरे स्त्रियोग्रे |” | ततो नित्यानुगस्तेषां विदितात्मा महामतिः । ृद्दान्तश्च शान्तश्च रामे च द्ढमक्तिमान्‌

verses.sloka: गात्रेषु वलय: प्राप्ता: श्वेताश्चैव शिरोरुहा: ।जरया पुरुषो जीर्ण: किं हि कृत्वा प्रभावयेत् ॥ २.१०५.२३॥
verses.transliteration: gātreṣu valaya: prāptā: śvetāścaiva śiroruhā: ।jarayā puruṣo jīrṇa: kiṁ hi kṛtvā prabhāvayet ॥ 2.105.23॥

translations.english: Wrinkels form on the body and hair turns grey in old age. In this way, decayed with age, what can a man do to have control over death.

verses.sloka: नन्दन्त्युदित आदित्ये नन्दन्त्यस्तमिते रवौ ।आत्मनो नावबुध्यन्ते मनुष्या जीवितक्षयम् ॥ २.१०५.२४॥
verses.transliteration: nandantyudita āditye nandantyastamite ravau ।ātmano nāvabudhyante manuṣyā jīvitakṣayam ॥ 2.105.24॥

translations.english: People rejoice when the Sun rises and rejoice when the Sun sets. But they are unaware of the decline of the life span of their own.
translations.hindi: रमणीय और सदा फूले हुए बन में होकर बहने बाली मदाकिनी के छुन्दर घाट पर, वे लोग अति कष्ट से गिरते पड़ते पहुँचे

verses.sloka: हृष्यन्त्यृतुमखं दृष्ट्वा नवं नवमिहागतम् ।ऋतूनां परिवर्त्तेन प्राणिनां प्राणसंक्षय: ॥ २.१०५.२५॥
verses.transliteration: hṛṣyantyṛtumakhaṁ dṛṣṭvā navaṁ navamihāgatam ।ṛtūnāṁ parivarttena prāṇināṁ prāṇasaṁkṣaya: ॥ 2.105.25॥

translations.english: At the advent of each new season men feel delighted to see the newly blossomed flowers and fruits. But with the change of the scasons the life span also diminishes.

verses.sloka: यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महार्णवे ।समेत्य च व्यपेयातां कालमासाद्य कञ्चन ॥ २.१०५.२६॥
verses.transliteration: yathā kāṣṭhaṁ ca kāṣṭhaṁ ca sameyātāṁ mahārṇave ।sametya ca vyapeyātāṁ kālamāsādya kañcana ॥ 2.105.26॥

translations.english: In a mighty ocean, two pieces of logs meet one another, float together and in due course get separated. In the same way wives, sons, relatives and riches remain together for some time and thereafter get separated. Their separation is certain.
translations.hindi: उस समय महाराज श्रीरामचन्द्रजी अंजली में जल भर और दक्षिण की ओर मुख कर रुदन करते हुए बोले

verses.sloka: एवं भार्याश्च पुत्राश्च ज्ञातयश्च घनानि च ।समेत्य व्यवधावन्ति ध्रुवो ह्येषां विनाभव: ॥ २.१०५.२७॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ bhāryāśca putrāśca jñātayaśca ghanāni ca ।sametya vyavadhāvanti dhruvo hyeṣāṁ vinābhava: ॥ 2.105.27॥

translations.english: In a mighty ocean, two pieces of logs meet one another, float together and in due course get separated. In the same way wives, sons, relatives and riches remain together for some time and thereafter get separated. Their separation is certain.
translations.hindi: हे राजशादूल ! आज यह मेरा दिआ हुआ जल, पिठलोक सें आप को अक्षय्य हो कर मिले

verses.sloka: नात्र कश्चिद्यथाभावं प्राणी समभिवर्त्तते ।तेन तस्मिन्न सामर्थ्यं प्रेतस्यास्त्यनुशोचत: ॥ २.१०५.२८॥
verses.transliteration: nātra kaścidyathābhāvaṁ prāṇī samabhivarttate ।tena tasminna sāmarthyaṁ pretasyāstyanuśocata: ॥ 2.105.28॥

translations.english: No living being in this world can act as he likes. Therefore, no one should grieve for the dead.

verses.sloka: यथा हि सार्थं गच्छन्तं ब्रूयात् कश्चित् पथि स्थित: ।अहमप्यागमिष्यामि पृष्ठतो भवतामिति ॥ २.१०५.२९॥
verses.transliteration: yathā hi sārthaṁ gacchantaṁ brūyāt kaścit pathi sthita: ।ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi pṛṣṭhato bhavatāmiti ॥ 2.105.29॥

translations.english: Like a man standing on the wayside says to a passing caravan, 'I am following you', and follows them, the road taken by our fathers and forefathers is certain for every one and cannot be violated by a person treading that path. (So) why should a man grieve?

verses.sloka: एवं पूर्वैर्गतो मार्ग: पितृपैतामहो ध्रुव: ।तमापन्न: कथं शोचेद्यस्ऺय नास्ति व्यतिक्रम: ॥ २.१०५.३०॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ pūrvairgato mārga: pitṛpaitāmaho dhruva: ।tamāpanna: kathaṁ śocedyasऺya nāsti vyatikrama: ॥ 2.105.30॥

translations.english: Like a man standing on the wayside says to a passing caravan, 'I am following you', and follows them, the road taken by our fathers and forefathers is certain for every one and cannot be violated by a person treading that path. (So) why should a man grieve?
translations.hindi: हे महाराज ! आज कल हम लोग जो खाते हैं, वही इस समय आप भोजन कीजिए । क्योंकि मनुष्य जा स्वय खाता हे; उसीसे वह अपने देवताओं को भी सन्तुष्ट करता है

verses.sloka: वयस: पतमानस्य स्रोतसो वा ऽनिवर्तिन: ।आत्मा सुखे नियोक्तव्य: सुखभाज: प्रजा: स्मृता: ॥ २.१०५.३१॥
verses.transliteration: vayasa: patamānasya srotaso vā 'nivartina: ।ātmā sukhe niyoktavya: sukhabhāja: prajā: smṛtā: ॥ 2.105.31॥

translations.english: Like the flow of water which never reverts to its source, age passes. Therefore, a man must employ his self in righteous acts that bring him happiness. By doing so, it is said, people will always be happy.
translations.hindi: निबापं--पिणडप्रद नं | ( गो० ) ॐ “पक्का तदन (सोः ) ४ 0 ९६० अयोध्याकाण्डे फिर नरश्रेष्ठ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी जिस मागे से नदी के किनारे पर उतर कर आए थे, उसी मार्ग से नदी के तट को छोड़, उस अनेर शिखर वाले पर्वत पर चढ गए

verses.sloka: धर्मात्मा स शुभै: कृत्स्नै: क्रतुभिश्चाप्तदक्षिणैः ।धूतपापो गत: स्वर्गं पिता न: पृथिवीपति: ॥ २.१०५.३२॥
verses.transliteration: dharmātmā sa śubhai: kṛtsnai: kratubhiścāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ।dhūtapāpo gata: svargaṁ pitā na: pṛthivīpati: ॥ 2.105.32॥

translations.english: Our righteous father and lord of the earth, Dasaratha, attained heaven by giving abundant charities and performing several sacrifices in accordance with tradition.

verses.sloka: भृत्यानां भरणात् सम्यक् प्रजानां परिपालनात् ।अर्थादानाच्च धर्मेण पिता नस्त्रिदिवं गत: ॥ २.१०५.३३॥
verses.transliteration: bhṛtyānāṁ bharaṇāt samyak prajānāṁ paripālanāt ।arthādānācca dharmeṇa pitā nastridivaṁ gata: ॥ 2.105.33॥

translations.english: Our father nourished his dependents, splendidly governed his subjects and accepted wealth through righteous ways. Because of these pious acts, he could go to heaven.
translations.hindi: उस समय चारों राजकुमारो और सीता के, गजते हुए सिंहों की दृहाड़ जैसे रोने के शब्द से पर्वत गूंज उठा

verses.sloka: कर्मभिस्तु शुभैरिष्टै: क्रतुभिश्चाप्तदक्षिणै: ।स्वर्गं दशरथ: प्राप्त: पिता न: पृथिवीपति: ॥ २.१०५.३४॥
verses.transliteration: karmabhistu śubhairiṣṭai: kratubhiścāptadakṣiṇai: ।svargaṁ daśaratha: prāpta: pitā na: pṛthivīpati: ॥ 2.105.34॥

translations.english: Dasaratha, our father and lord of the earth, reached heaven by performing auspicious acts and offering abundant charities in sacrifices.

verses.sloka: इष्ट्वा बहुविधैर्यज्ञैर्भोगांश्चावाप्य पुष्कलान् ।उत्तमं चायुरासाद्य स्वर्गत: पृथिवीपति: ॥ २.१०५.३५॥
verses.transliteration: iṣṭvā bahuvidhairyajñairbhogāṁścāvāpya puṣkalān ।uttamaṁ cāyurāsādya svargata: pṛthivīpati: ॥ 2.105.35॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha, lord of the earth, having performed various kinds of sacrifices and securing a long life, enjoyed abundance of pleasures and attained heaven.
translations.hindi: वे आपस में कहन लगे कि, श्रीरामचन्द्र सं भरत की भेंट अबश्य हो गई । क्‍योंकि पिता के मरने का संवाद सुन वे अत्यन्त शो काकुल हो विलाप कर रहे हैं

verses.sloka: आयुरुत्तममासाद्य भोगानपि च राघव: ।स न शोच्य: पिता तात: स्वर्गत: सत्कृत: सताम् ॥ २.१०५.३६॥
verses.transliteration: āyuruttamamāsādya bhogānapi ca rāghava: ।sa na śocya: pitā tāta: svargata: satkṛta: satām ॥ 2.105.36॥

translations.english: O dear our father, king Dasaratha, who was honoured by the virtuous and enjoyed the best of pleasures attained heaven after a long life. Therefore, he is not to be grieved over.
translations.hindi: चारों भाइयों का समागम देखने के लिए लोग अनेक प्रकार के बाहनों पर सवार हो'कर गए । उन बाहूनो के पशुओं के खुरों का और पहियों का बड़ा शब्द हुआ

verses.sloka: स जीर्णं मानुषं देहं परित्यज्य पिता हि न: ।दैवीमृद्धिमनुप्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकविहारिणीम् ॥ २.१०५.३७॥
verses.transliteration: sa jīrṇaṁ mānuṣaṁ dehaṁ parityajya pitā hi na: ।daivīmṛddhimanuprāpto brahmalokavihāriṇīm ॥ 2.105.37॥

translations.english: Our father, king Dasaratha, abandoned the wornout mortal body, and obtained divine prosperity of wandering in the world of Brahma.

verses.sloka: तं तु नैवंविध: कश्चित् प्राज्ञ: शोचितुमर्हति ।तद्विधो यद्विधश्चापि श्रुतवान् बुद्धिमत्तर: ॥ २.१०५.३८॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ tu naivaṁvidha: kaścit prājña: śocitumarhati ।tadvidho yadvidhaścāpi śrutavān buddhimattara: ॥ 2.105.38॥

translations.english: No one like you or me should ever mourn about this highly sagacious and learned king who was proficient in scriptural knowledge.
translations.hindi: यद्यपि राम के अयोध्या छोड़े अभी बहुत दिन नहीं हुए थे, तथापि उन सब के ऐसा जान पड़ता था कि, मानां श्रीरास का अयोध्या छोडे बहुत दिन बीत गए हैं । अतएव राम का देखने की उत्कण्ठा से प्रेरित हो वे सब उनके आश्रम में पहुँचे

verses.sloka: एते बहुविधा: शोका विलापरुदिते तथा ।वर्जनीया हि धीरेण सर्वावस्थासु धीमता ॥ २.१०५.३९॥
verses.transliteration: ete bahuvidhā: śokā vilāparudite tathā ।varjanīyā hi dhīreṇa sarvāvasthāsu dhīmatā ॥ 2.105.39॥

translations.english: A wise man, holding on to his fortitude in all circumstances, should avoid such occasions of grief, these words of lamentation and this crying.

verses.sloka: स स्वस्थो भव माशोचीर्यात्वा चावस तां पुरीम् ।तथा पित्रा नियुक्तो ऽसि वशिना वदतां वर ॥ २.१०५.४०॥
verses.transliteration: sa svastho bhava māśocīryātvā cāvasa tāṁ purīm ।tathā pitrā niyukto 'si vaśinā vadatāṁ vara ॥ 2.105.40॥

translations.english: O foremost of the eloquent, compose yourself. Do not grieve. Return to the city (Ayodhya) and reside there. You have been commanded so by our father who was a man of selfcontrol.
translations.hindi: उस ससय उन वाहनों के पझुओं के खुरों और पहियों की आहट से वह स्थान उसी प्रकार शाञ्द्रायमान हुश्रा, जिस प्रकार मेंचों के समागम में, आकाश शब्दायमान होता है

verses.sloka: यत्राहमपि तेनैव नियुक्त: पुण्यकर्मणा ।तत्रैवाहं करिष्यामि पितुरार्य्यस्य शासनम् ॥ २.१०५.४१॥
verses.transliteration: yatrāhamapi tenaiva niyukta: puṇyakarmaṇā ।tatraivāhaṁ kariṣyāmi piturāryyasya śāsanam ॥ 2.105.41॥

translations.english: I shall also stick to the command of our noble father who was a man of sacred deeds.
translations.hindi: उस शब्द से डर कर हथिनियों सहित हाथी अपने मद की गन्धि से वन को सुवासित करते हुए, उस वन को छोड़ - दूसरे बन में चले गए

verses.sloka: न मया शासनं तस्य त्यक्तुं न्याय्यमरिन्दम ।तत् त्वयापि सदा मान्यं स वै बन्धु: स न: पिता ॥ २.१०५.४२॥
verses.transliteration: na mayā śāsanaṁ tasya tyaktuṁ nyāyyamarindama ।tat tvayāpi sadā mānyaṁ sa vai bandhu: sa na: pitā ॥ 2.105.42॥

translations.english: O subduer of enemies, I cannot violate the order of the king. You also must respect it for he is our father and friend indeed.
translations.hindi: चक्रब्राक, जलसुर्ग, हंस, कारण्डव, प्लव नामक जलपक्षी, कोकिल, क्रोंच ये सब पक्षी उस शब्द से, संज्ञाहीन से हो इधर उधर भाग गए

verses.sloka: तद्वच: पितुरेवाहं सम्मतं धर्मचारिण: ।कर्मणा पालयिष्यामि वनवासेन राघव ॥ २.१०५.४३॥
verses.transliteration: tadvaca: piturevāhaṁ sammataṁ dharmacāriṇa: ।karmaṇā pālayiṣyāmi vanavāsena rāghava ॥ 2.105.43॥

translations.english: O Bharata, I will, therefore, obey the command of our venerable father, the champion of righteousness, by living in the forest.

verses.sloka: धीर्मिकेणानृशंसेन नरेण गुरुवर्त्तिना ।भवितव्यं नरव्याघ्र परलोकं जिगीषता ॥ २.१०५.४४॥
verses.transliteration: dhīrmikeṇānṛśaṁsena nareṇa guruvarttinā ।bhavitavyaṁ naravyāghra paralokaṁ jigīṣatā ॥ 2.105.44॥

translations.english: O best of men, if a man aspires to conquer the higher world, he should remain virtuous, compassionate and obedient to his preceptors.
translations.hindi: उस शब्द से त्रस्त पक्षियों से ढका हुआ आकाश और मनुष्य से आच्छादित प्रथ्वी दोनों ही अत्यन्त शोभायमान हुए

verses.sloka: आत्मानमनुतिष्ठ त्वं स्वभावेन नरर्षभ ।निशाम्य तु शुभं वृत्तं पितुर्दशरथस्य न: ॥ २.१०५.४५॥
verses.transliteration: ātmānamanutiṣṭha tvaṁ svabhāvena nararṣabha ।niśāmya tu śubhaṁ vṛttaṁ piturdaśarathasya na: ॥ 2.105.45॥

translations.english: O best of men, having seen the auspicious life of our father Dasaratha and his conduct, you also stick to your own duty.

verses.sloka: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं महात्मा पितुर्निदेशप्रतिपालनार्थम् ।यवीयसं भ्रातरमर्थवच्च प्रभुर्मुहूर्ताद्विरराम राम: ॥ २.१०५.४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktvā vacanaṁ mahātmā piturnideśapratipālanārtham ।yavīyasaṁ bhrātaramarthavacca prabhurmuhūrtādvirarāma rāma: ॥ 2.105.46 ॥

translations.english: Rama, the magnanimous lord, addressed his younger brother Bharata with words full of significance, saying, Obey father's command and remained silent in a moment. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the one hundredfifth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: एकमनसः- समानह्ृदयाः । ( शि० ) द्य चरशतंतमः सगः ६६१ वे सत्र सैनिक अपने डेरों का छोड, जिस ओर से रोने का शब्द सुन पढ़ता था, उस ओर सुख कर और एक मन हो दौड़ पड़े
